zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.22** 修复机器人把复核失败错误归因于“同一个模型、同一条渠道”。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: 执行与复核可以使用相同模型和渠道。独立复核使用单独的审查上下文，固定的用户选择继续生效；不会为了取得“独立性”要求更换配置。
验证详情补充近期复核尝试的真实错误、未满足标准和缺失证据，区分历史记录与当前版本。机器人应根据这些记录说明问题，不能把“同源”标记当作失败原因。
移除委托工具内部无条件偏向其他来源的提示，保留用户配置的候选排序和故障切换范围。
同步中英文模型配置说明、README、发布说明和站点更新日志。保留 RC21 的大历史执行性能修复。

zh.title: 升级与验收范围
items: 历史失败记录和验收结果保留；本次更新不会把旧任务自动改成通过。缺失的证据仍需补齐并通过正常复核。
同模型配置保留、验证失败诊断、重启读取及复核成功后的完成和签收有定向测试。隔离真实模型诊断与标准产品回归分别验证，不把合成任务记录当作真实项目交付。
升级前备份完整数据根，并同步升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。产品截图由实施者自审；完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装及长期日用不在本轮验收范围内。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.22** fixes incorrect explanations that attributed verification failure to using the same model and channel. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Execution and verification may use the same model and channel. Independent verification uses a separate review context while preserving fixed user selections; another model is not required to establish independence.

Verification details now include recent recorded errors, failed criteria and missing evidence, distinguishing historical attempts from the current source version. The bot should explain these findings rather than treating shared model provenance as a failure reason.
Remove the delegation tool's unconditional preference hint for another source while retaining user-configured candidate ordering and recovery boundaries.
Synchronize bilingual model guidance, README, release notes and the documentation changelog. Retain RC21's large-history execution performance fixes.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Preserve historical failures and acceptance results. Updating does not automatically pass older tasks; missing evidence still requires normal verification.

Focused tests cover fixed same-model selections, failure diagnostics, restart reads and completion and acceptance after successful review. Isolated real-model diagnostics and standard product regression are checked separately; generated task records do not constitute real project delivery.

Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Product screenshots receive implementer self-review. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this acceptance scope.
